quest_barkeep_main.name: End the evening of bloodlust
quest_barkeep_main.description: Deuhtsh requested that {pl.subject} end the evening of bloodlust.

start.name: Seek out monsters to kill.
start.description: When {pl.subject} woke up in that bar, the barkeep had a strange request for {pl.object}. {pl.subject} should roam the world and kill and blood-infested monsters that we come across. However, he didn't give {pl.object} any directions...

return.name: Return to Deuhtsh's bar in the starting village.
return.description: That should have been enough monsters/various other poor creatures of questionable morality. {pl.subject} should return to the bar now, to claim {subject.poss_adjective} promised bottle of 'The really good stuff'.

find_other_way.name: Find a different Way into the bar.
find_other_way.description: The tunnel leading to the bar's cellar seems to have collapsed. {pl.subject} have to find another way in.

kill_guardian.name: Kill the massive beast guarding the bar.
kill_guardian.description: A massive beast appeared, which seems to be guarding the bar. Guess this drink Deuhtsh offered is more popular than {pl.subject} thought... There is no way around killing it.

claim_reward.name: Claim the promised bottle of 'the really good stuff'.
claim_reward.description: After defeating the foul beast in front of the bar, nothing is stopping {pl.object} from going into the bar.

end_drunk_reward.name: Drunk the 'really good stuff'
end_drunk_reward.description: As {pl.poss_adjective} lips touched the glass, {pl.poss_adjective} vision blurred and {pl.object} got sleepy... Perfect time for a nap.

kill_barkeep.name: Kill the perpetrator behind the evening of bloodlust - Blood-Drunk Deuhtsh.
kill_barkeep.description: As it turned out, Deuhtsh was the one responsible for the evening of bloodlust all along. Knowing that, {pl.poss_adjective} final target for completing the quest should be obvious.

end_killed_barkeep.name: Killed Blood-Drunk Deuhtsh and put an end to the evening of bloodlust.
end_killed_barkeep.description: {pl.subject} killed Deuhtsh, who was responsible for the evening of Bloodlust. With that, the lands are free from the curse!
